cd /workspace/submission && cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# Synecdoche discovery-to-deployment (contract v3.0)

`run.py` reads one JSON request on stdin and writes one JSON certificate on
stdout. Every stage is offline and deterministic; nothing is trained beyond the
pinned scikit-learn backup tree and no network, capture or switch access exists.

## Module map

| path | role |
| --- | --- |
| `run.py` | entry point: site/native bootstrap, request read, single JSON response, `{"error":"invalid_request"}` on any rejected input |
| `formats.py` | syntax + aggregate budget validation (depth, containers, shapes, integer tokens, value encoding, per-request totals) |
| `pipeline.py` | per-release calibration pipeline and catalog assembly |
| `offline_discovery/rule_generate.py` | activation-run fragment extraction, exact anchor distance, density clustering, generalized interval bounds |
| `offline_discovery/rule_remove.py` | validation coverage (`hits`), exact rational score/kept/priority, exact-bank key counting |
| `online_matching/train_rf.py` | pinned `DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=10, random_state=42, class_weight='balanced')` training, native node certificate, integer prediction |
| `online_matching/match_p4.py` | deployed suffix matcher: per-length bitmask tables so a packet costs one AND per coordinate and the lowest set bit is the highest-priority cluster |
| `sessions.py` | atomic installs, resident bank pools, flow epochs, direction/idle/segment/limit/close commitment order |

## Exactness notes

* `high` positions, the `eps` neighbour test and the `trunc(lo ± sigma)` bounds
  are decided with integer arithmetic (`u² > V`,
  `sum·q²·9^A <= L·p²·25^A`, `isqrt`-based floor/trunc). Floating point is only
  a fast pre-filter; any pair landing inside a 1e-12 relative band around
  `eps²` is re-decided exactly.
* Scores and the kept test use `fractions.Fraction`, so `score > threshold` and
  the emitted reduced `[p, q]` pair are exact.
* The tree certificate stores `2*threshold`, and replay predicts with
  `2*feature <= 2*threshold`, matching the pinned library's integer features.

## Layout invariants relied on by the runtime limits

* fragments are grouped by `(class, length)` and identical sequences are
  deduplicated before the distance matrix, so the pairwise stage is bounded by
  unique sequences (length ≤ `width` ≤ 16).
* calibration prunes validation rows through a transposed distinct-value prefix
  table before any window scan, and identical patterns share one coverage pass.
* matcher bit tables are built lazily on first use of a release bank.
EOF
